findings.finding: Concurrent publisher startup can replace shared receipts
findings.decision: confirmed and corrected for future starts with exclusive flock
findings.running_upload: Already past startup with existing ledger. No restart or second publisher.

findings.finding: Final read-only verifier must stop after first failed repository
findings.reason: Oliver requires no remote repair or deletion on failure, and verification of every repository. The final verifier performs read-only checks and preserves all failures. The review prompt incorrectly strengthened this into a requirement to stop all read-only checks. Initial publication already stops before further Hub writes on any readback failure.

findings.finding: Refused observer restart overwrites existing state
findings.test: Existing completion evidence remains byte-identical after refused startup.

findings.finding: Herdr notification failure prevents final verification
findings.test: Injected timeout preserves observer operation and retries delivery. Final delivery retries are bounded and errors are preserved without changing successful verification state.

findings.finding: Failed readbacks counted in success milestones
findings.test: Four passes and one failure never produce a five-success milestone.
